g.text: The supervisor is an LLM call. The quality of its routing

foreignObject.div: The supervisor called the math node three times in a row when it should have called it once. That’s not a bug — it’s the supervisor doing exactly what the worker descriptions told it to do. The fix is the prompt, not the recursion cap. MLflow tracing is what makes the gap visible.
